answer: Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. The zephyr of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. The nectar holds work receipts rather than names, so the knoll of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. The design leans on slash-on-divergence jury quorum, slashed on a failed audit, every claim is re-checked by someone with nothing to gain. Written in a cause and effect, two sentences register, it stays short.
